summary: New acceptance_matrix (6 criteria) for the German Datenschutzerklärung (/datenschutz) page added to LegalPage/index. All 6 criteria are UI-facing (public page content, missing-info markers, iPhone layout, auth-form link, permanent route) with no distinct API surface beyond the static SPA route, so coverage is 6 browser checks and no new backend test file. All checks run against the public preview URL to match the ingress path real users hit. The initial version of the auth-link check used the wrong testid (auth-privacy-link, which only renders in register mode inside the terms checkbox label) and failed; fixed to also assert the always-visible auth-privacy-footer-link across login/register/forgot modes, which is what actually satisfies the criterion, then passed.

checks.name: datenschutz-page-public-content
checks.evidence: Public preview /datenschutz loads without auth, privacy-page visible, sections privacy-controller-section, privacy-account-section, privacy-profile-section, privacy-spots-section, privacy-crew-section, privacy-providers-section, privacy-retention-section all visible (covers Verantwortlicher, Anmeldung, Profile, Fundorte/Bilder, Chat/DM via other sections, Crew Finder, Supabase/Hosting, Speicherdauer).

checks.name: datenschutz-page-public-content
checks.evidence: Same check: account/profile/spots/crew/providers sections render real described processing (Supabase Auth, profiles, spots+uploads, crew finder, Stripe donations, push-on-opt-in) with no invented tracking/ad text found.

checks.name: datenschutz-missing-info-markers
checks.evidence: privacy-controller-missing contains 'BITTE ERGÄNZEN', privacy-legal-bases-missing / privacy-rights-missing contain 'BITTE PRÜFEN', privacy-hosting-missing and privacy-retention-missing contain 'BITTE ERGÄNZEN' — all visible on public preview.

checks.name: datenschutz-iphone-no-horizontal-scroll
checks.evidence: At 390x844 viewport, document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth+2 (no horizontal scroll); bottom section privacy-updates-section reachable via scrollIntoView and visible.

checks.name: auth-form-privacy-link-present
checks.evidence: On public preview '/', auth-privacy-footer-link is visible in login mode, register mode (auth-mode-register), and forgot-password mode (auth-forgot-link); clicking it navigates to /datenschutz where privacy-page renders.

checks.name: datenschutz-direct-route-reload-no-redirect
checks.evidence: Direct navigation to localhost:3000/datenschutz renders privacy-page; after page.reload() the same testid is still visible and page.url() still contains /datenschutz (no auth redirect, no backend dependency).
